title: PURSUE sensor videos: viability triage (134 clips)
summary: Which of the 2026 PURSUE releases carry enough on-screen data to reconstruct anything, and how much.

event.date_uncertainty: Many events across Releases 01 to 06; dates are per clip.

sources.title: Hand-built clip-by-clip triage table
sources.provenance: Built by the lab from the released videos; see data/pursue/ for the index checks.

verdict.text: Of 134 PURSUE sensor videos triaged, 16 support at most a bounded reconstruction and 118 are not viable (most on-screen data is redacted and there is no known scale). No clip in this triage is claimed to identify its object.
conditions: Tiers are about what the data could support, not about what the objects are.
Triage is by sampled frames and the released symbology; a re-check at frame level can change a tier.

notes: Frozen clips that are fully scored export as their own clip_case files.
